# pluto_policy (Resource)

A Pluto policy. Policies this provider writes are marked managed by Terraform, and the dashboard warns that edits made there are reverted on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pluto_policy" "notetakers" {
  name             = "Block AI notetakers"
  category         = "AI Notetakers"
  policy_type      = "block"
  enforcement_tool = "Falcon"
  tools            = ["Otter", "Fireflies"]

  targeted_scopes = [{
    type   = "user_department"
    values = ["Engineering"]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Policy category, e.g. "AI Notetakers". Changing it replaces the policy.
- `enforcement_tool` (String) Enforcement integration as the API names it, e.g. "Falcon", or "Monitor" for detect policies. Changing it replaces the policy.
- `name` (String)
- `policy_type` (String) allow, block, detect (Monitor), or warn (Runtime Enforcement only).

### Optional

- `custom_message` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `notify_end_user` (Boolean)
- `targeted_scopes` (Attributes List) Who the policy applies to. Empty applies it to everyone. Omit to leave the stored scoping alone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targeted_scopes))
- `tools` (Set of String) Names of the tools the policy targets. Omit to leave the stored selection alone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--targeted_scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targeted_scopes`

Required:

- `type` (String) Selector type: user_tag, endpoint_tag, user_department, user_title, specific_user, specific_endpoint or agent.
- `values` (Set of String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Bring an existing policy under Terraform using its id.
terraform import pluto_policy.notetakers <policy id>
```
